memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "They took the things Moses commanded to the front of the tent of meeting, and the entire assembly came near and stood before the LORD." - Lev 9:5 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The entire assembly came near and stood before the LORD.

Think about the size of that. Hundreds of thousands of people — families, children, the elderly — gathering in front of one tent and standing together in God's presence.

Nobody was excluded. Not the poor, not the unimportant, not the ones with complicated histories. The entire assembly.

There is a picture here of what God has always wanted. Not a select few admitted while the rest wait outside, but a whole people drawn near.

The New Testament makes the picture larger still. Hebrews describes what believers have come to: thousands upon thousands of angels in joyful assembly, to the church of the firstborn... to God, the Judge of all (Heb 12:22-23). And Revelation shows a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people and language (Rev 7:9).

Notice also that they stood. Not scattered, not busy elsewhere, not observing from a distance. Present, attentive, waiting.

There is value in simply showing up — gathering with God's people, standing where He has promised to be. Some of the most important things in the Christian life happen to those who are simply there.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Am I present with God's people, or drifting toward the edges?
2. When did I last simply stand before God with no agenda but to be there?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You call a whole people to Yourself, and that includes me. Help me to be present rather than distant. Amen.
